title: Windows live tests that build an embedded fixture with Cargo fail with LNK1104 when the test temp root is deep (output path over MAX_PATH)
outcome: On Windows, tests that build a fixture under the test temp root either keep their output paths well under MAX_PATH whatever the temp root (short fixture labels or a short target dir inside the fixture), or fail fast before building with a clear message naming the computed path length and the temp-root setting to shorten. The repository-local temp root documented for agents is short enough by default.
acceptance: Windows live tests that build an embedded fixture with Cargo fail with LNK1104 when the test temp root is deep (output path over MAX_PATH) is done
